_about: 3-13, won by killing the anti-portal agent (step 171, R17). Left off the shelf onto the crate, right
off its far side, and left again: the crate is pushed until it drops into the 64 px gap by the key's
block (released on tick 187; later and it slides over the gap and jams under the column). Over it to
the far wall, taking the blue key. From x 9.8 a shot at (70, 70) passes left of the block under the
agent and comes within 22.4 of anti_portal_agent_ent_1536 (82, 84): the agent and antiportal_1520, the
208 px field over the whole left of the level, are gone on tick ~345. A portal by the blue keyhole at
(380, 178), one on the player: the blue key opens it and the yellow key is taken. Right through where
the blue door stood, down, left to x 412. A portal over breakable_wall_1542 at (310, 360) and one
beside rolling_stone_1540 at (100, 298): the stone drops onto the wall and breaks it (tick 720). Left
into the hole, onto the stone; a portal in the corridor at (240, 466), one on the player; left past
keyhole_ent_1197 (the yellow door goes) to the door. Won on tick 1027 (step 171).
